summary: The step pictures carry most of the faults: pale blue blobs with dark centers sit where the cow will stand from step 1 until the cow covers them in step 11, and filter-like mirrored tile patterns show in the sky (steps 1-3) and lower hillside (step 7). The words often don't match the pictures: grass tops placed 2 in too high (steps 8, 10), single-paint steps whose pictures add many unnamed colors (7, 13, 16), and stock shape and blend lines that contradict the picture (1, 11, 14, 15). Step 13 also finishes the face with no words for it.
